scripts.fmt: biome format --write && biome check --write && cargo fmt
scripts.lint: tsc && biome check --error-on-warnings && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
scripts.export: bun run build-tiles && next build && bun run scripts/build-sw.ts
scripts.graph-inputs: bun run scripts/write-plan.ts --key-space && cargo run --bin tiler -- graph-inputs --plan .build/key-space-plan.json --report .build/graph-inputs.json
scripts.tree-data-finish: cargo run --release --bin tiler -- ingest --params .build/ingest.json --report .build/ingest-report.json && bun run scripts/tree-data-manifest.ts
scripts.build-tree-data:nyc: bun run scripts/tree-data-fetch.ts --city nyc && bun run tree-data-finish
scripts.build-tree-data:sf: bun run scripts/tree-data-fetch.ts --city sf && bun run tree-data-finish
scripts.build-tree-data: bun run build-tree-data:nyc && bun run build-tree-data:sf
scripts.build-ndsm: bun run scripts/lidar.ts && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- ndsm --params .build/ndsm-downtown.json --report .build/ndsm-report.json
scripts.build-east-bay-heights: bun run scripts/east-bay-buildings.ts && bun run scripts/lidar.ts --window=east-bay --footprints=.build/east-bay-footprints.geojson --heights=.build/east-bay-heights.json && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- ndsm --params .build/ndsm-east-bay.json --report .build/ndsm-east-bay-report.json
scripts.shed-index: set -e; dir=${SHED_SNAPSHOTS:-.cache/ActiveShedPermits}; mkdir -p .build; git -C $dir log --reverse --format='%H:data/Active_Sheds2.csv %H %ct%n%H:Active_Sheds2.csv %H %ct' HEAD > .build/shed-commits.txt; git -C $dir cat-file --batch-check='%(objectname) %(objecttype) %(rest)' < .build/shed-commits.txt > .build/shed-index.txt
scripts.build-sheds: set -eo pipefail; bun run key-probe && bun run graph-inputs && bun run shed-mirror && bun run shed-index && bun run shed-blobs | git -C ${SHED_SNAPSHOTS:-.cache/ActiveShedPermits} cat-file --batch | bun run scripts/build-sheds.ts .build/shed-index.txt
scripts.shed-walk: set -eo pipefail; bun run shed-mirror && bun run shed-index && bun run shed-blobs | git -C ${SHED_SNAPSHOTS:-.cache/ActiveShedPermits} cat-file --batch | bun run scripts/shed-permits.ts .build/shed-index.txt
scripts.shed-drill: set -eo pipefail; bun run shed-mirror && bun run shed-index && bun run shed-blobs | git -C ${SHED_SNAPSHOTS:-.cache/ActiveShedPermits} cat-file --batch | bun run scripts/shed-drill.ts .build/shed-index.txt
scripts.check-shed-inputs: bun run key-probe && bun run graph-inputs && bun run scripts/check-shed-inputs.ts
scripts.build-tiles: bun run scripts/serve-sources.ts && bun run scripts/write-plan.ts && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- build --plan .build/plan.json
scripts.build-tiles:half: bun run scripts/serve-sources.ts && bun run scripts/write-plan.ts && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- build --plan .build/plan.json --jobs half
scripts.build-tiles:graph: bun run scripts/serve-sources.ts && bun run scripts/write-plan.ts && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- build --plan .build/plan.json --jobs half --only graph
scripts.build-tiles:shade: bun run scripts/serve-sources.ts && bun run scripts/write-plan.ts && cargo run --release --bin tiler -- build --plan .build/plan.json --jobs half --only shade
scripts.update-sheds: set -eo pipefail; from=$(bun run scripts/shed-window.ts); dir=${SHED_SNAPSHOTS:-.cache/ActiveShedPermits}; test -d $dir || git clone --bare --shallow-since=$from https://github.com/NYCDOB/ActiveShedPermits.git $dir; git -C $dir fetch --all --tags --force; bun run shed-index; bun run shed-blobs --from $from | git -C $dir cat-file --batch | bun run scripts/update-sheds.ts .build/shed-index.txt
